results.title: Traitors 2: Kamya Punjabi slams Mallika Sherawat over ‘jail’ comment for Rhea Chakraborty: ‘Such a toxic personal attack’
results.description: Kamya Punjabi has voiced her disapproval of Mallika Sherawat’s comments regarding Rhea Chakraborty’s past, labeling them as a harmful personal attack rather than constructive criticism. Additionally, she shared her thoughts on The Traitors 2, expressing her frustration over the players' overly cautious strategies, which she felt lacked the necessary boldness to captivate viewers.
